distinct_mission: BI01 Budget Overview and an auxiliary annual-budget KPI, separate from both previously executed BI08 milestone variants.

data_origin.kind: Explicit synthetic raw business rows in an isolated authenticated installation; all scopes, projections, cases, artifacts and receipts are produced by installed ports.
data_origin.currency: USD is only the human case currency. All Dashboard amounts retain the producer's unspecified currency; no FX or relabeling is introduced.
data_origin.summing_assertions: sumObserved rejects absent/non-numeric values before testing parity of already observed producer components. It never turns a missing cell into zero.

producer_and_discovery: Issue actual Budget Overview/budgetSeries and Budget Overview/budgetMetrics selections for the same full year.
Retain both producer-issued refs in one real human-created case; no opaque reference is put in the objective.
Discover the second ref by its public record type/page/fields/period in sf_case_read and qualify it with the exported dashboardMetricSelector format.
Prepare ContextualBIInput through the installed HTTP route; the input and persisted artifact retain exactly the BI01 series ref.
Require sf_case_read plus the four normative operations from the real model branch, matching actual payload digests and native result receipts.
Read Session messages explicitly in ascending order and require the case result in an earlier assistant message than the KPI call; order of parallel tool parts in one message is not discovery proof.
verification: The real Dashboard monthly effective values are non-uniform and equal the twelve explicit overrides; the sum and actual KPI are 78000, not the owner's nominal annual budget or a flat monthly series.
The KPI retains twelve components and missing totalActual/totalForecast even though totalBudget is available.
Every monthly value retains its own series source; the KPI result retains its separate metrics source. The two source scopes cannot be interchanged.
The authenticated UI dispatcher refuses a metric built from the series selector and refuses an altered period with source-unavailable.
The raw budget data and case remain unchanged by preparation and optional native execution.
After reopening the host, actual input/artifact/table/source links and UI KPI are revalidated; if a native mission exists, its output and exact Session tool evidence are reopened too.

consumer_boundaries.wp05: Actual bi-data/bi-source render the BI01 series with its equivalent table and drilldown. They do not consume the auxiliary KPI as a new chart/proposal field.
consumer_boundaries.auxiliary_kpi: Actual native tool structured result and bound receipt in the durable Session, with inputDigest/resultDigest/run/session/principal/call IDs. Without an installed model, only the authenticated UI dispatcher result is observed.
consumer_boundaries.proposal: Closed ContextualBIProposal and ContributionEnvelope evidenceRefs remain exactly the BI source; no additional metric ref or numeric claim is inserted into the output contract.

remaining_owner_gate.scope: The native input/tool surface still lacks the exact persisted canonicalProjectionRefs/tableRef demanded by the verifier. This driver neither creates that owner capability nor injects private IDs. With an available model, failure to produce the exact verified output remains a test failure.

hosted_selection.name: native contextual BI01 discovers its auxiliary KPI source through the real case and preserves separate chart and tool provenance after reload
